audiences.pain: schedule changes, crew coordination, handoff gaps, missed visibility

scale without adding administrative overhead at the same rate

customer_interviews: We already have a CRM. I need to know if AtlasOps sits beside it or if this turns into a replacement project.
The biggest headache is when the schedule changes at 6am and three people are working from different information.
I can see features, but I still don't understand what implementation looks like for a 40-person operation.
If this takes months to roll out, we cannot do it this season.
The mobile view matters because supervisors are almost never at a desk.
We need managers to see exceptions without asking dispatch for another spreadsheet.

experiments.change: added two verified implementation quotes near pricing CTA
experiments.caveat: single four-week period; no randomized holdout
